subject: MAP alignment: target close & procurement signature deadline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@olivepay.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@olivepay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (target close proposal)

Hi Sarah / Tom 

Great meeting today  
 really appreciated the deep dive on OlivePay's fraud detection and reconciliation use cases. Per our call, attaching the first draft of a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align milestones, owners, and target dates so procurement and legal have a clear path. Attachment: MAP_draft_v2.pdf (see milestones section).

High-level summary / proposed timeline:
- Target product/technical acceptance: Apr 5, 2027 (OlivePay validation window)
- Redwood to deliver final SOW and integration plan: Mar 18, 2027
- Procurement / contract signature target (proposed): Apr 15, 2027
- Deployment / pilot kickoff: Apr 25, 2027

Key responsibilities (draft):
- OlivePay: provide test data set, assign legal & procurement POC (name + email), complete procurement checklist
- Redwood: provide SOW, security evidence (SOC 2 excerpts), implementation runbook, and a dedicated CS lead (Camila)

Open items / dependencies:
- Procurement timelines (OlivePay internal board/quarterly approvals)
- Legal redlines and SLA adjustments
- Data processing addendum (DPA) sign-off if required

Next steps / asks (can we confirm by EOD Thu, Mar 18):
1) OlivePay to review the attached MAP and confirm target procurement signature deadline (we proposed Apr 15)
2) OlivePay procurement/legal contact(s) and any firm deadlines we should know about
3) Redwood to provide final SOW draft by Mar 18 (we'll attach a working draft next message)

Camila / Vivek  looping you in for technical and CS ownership. I'll update the MAP with any changes Sarah/Tom confirm.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP_draft_v2.pdf

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@olivepay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@olivepay.com>, procurement@olivepay.com
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (target close proposal)

Thanks Marissa  appreciated the clear summary and the MAP draft. Quick note from procurement: our next Exec Procurement Review is on Apr 22, which means the latest practical signature date is Apr 25 (gives us a couple days post-review to circulate final docs).

Two asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood move the proposed procurement/signature target to Apr 25 instead of Apr 15?
2) We'll send our procurement checklist (attached) and our legal POC is Tom Nguyen (cc'd)  he may have redlines.

If you can get the final SOW + answers to the procurement checklist by Mar 18, we can try to expedite the internal review.

-Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Strategic Programs | OlivePay
sarah.lee@olivepay.com

Attachments: OlivePay_procurement_checklist.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP timeline and procurement signature (internal)

Marissa / team 

Thanks for the thread. Procurement pushing to Apr 25 is reasonable to avoid a hard blocker, but a few internal flags to consider:
- Legal at OlivePay typically takes 10-14 business days for redlines on SOWs of this complexity (data + security clauses).
- We should include a short redline template and highlight standard Redwood DPA clauses to speed review.
- Suggest we set two timelines in the MAP: an "ambition" (target close Apr 15) and a "commitment" (signature Apr 25). That gives the customer an aspirational date while safeguarding internal expectations.

I'll draft an updated MAP and SOW changes with responsibilities called out (Neha: own SOW redline template; Camila: confirm implementation milestones).

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Manager, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@olivepay.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@olivepay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (target close proposal)

Thanks Sarah  appreciate the clarity. Attached is MAP_draft_v3.pdf and a working SOW draft (SOW_draft.docx).

Per Neha's suggestion, here's the updated proposal (reflected in MAP v3):
- Ambition target close: Apr 15, 2027 (we'll aim for faster internal approvals)
- Commitment signature date: Apr 25, 2027 (OlivePay Exec Procurement Review on Apr 22)

To hit the ambition date we will:
- Redwood to deliver final SOW and completed procurement checklist responses by Mar 18
- OlivePay to provide legal contact confirmation and prioritized redline list by Mar 18
- Redwood to provide a redline-ready SOW template and DPA excerpt to speed legal review (Neha owning)

Camila will own pilot scope and acceptance criteria; Vivek will coordinate runtime performance expectations and deployment windows.

Sarah / Tom  can you confirm you can get contract + procurement review materials to us by Mar 18 so we can preserve the option to close earlier? If not, we'll treat Apr 25 as the working signature date and update rollout milestone accordingly.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_draft_v3.pdf, SOW_draft.docx

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@olivepay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@olivepay.com>, procurement@olivepay.com
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP alignment: target close & procurement signature deadline

Hi Marissa  we can work to the two-tier plan. Confirming:
- Target close (ambition): Apr 15, 2027
- Commitment signature date: Apr 25, 2027

Condition: OlivePay procurement needs the final SOW + completed procurement checklist answers by Mar 18 to run the expedited path. If Redwood can deliver that by Mar 18 we will aim for signature on Apr 25; otherwise signature will slip to Apr 30 post next review cycle.

I'll flag internally and Tom will coordinate legal redlines.

Thanks  Sarah
